item.text:
Reconstructed all 24 verses across eight stanzas in Urdu script in [karbala-ae-karbala.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/48462dd0ad614a71a890d3f29f5cf4ae/src/data/lyrics/karbala-ae-karbala.md). Preserved the Roman wording and repetitions in `romanLyrics`, with capitalization adjusted for proper names. Set the direction to RTL and removed `noUrdu`.

In stanza 8, I rendered the ambiguous Roman “Zulma” phonetically as `ظُلما`.
